label: the far rock outpost
note: One of the Remnant's five outposts on the moon (Territory's 'moon' front, content/core/story/territory.json): the same building, troopers, droids and rules as the port's outposts (this file is remnant_outpost_far.json's, renamed), set out on the moon's rock as a landmark in content/core/planets/grit_station.json. Kill every trooper here and the locals move in; hold all five at once and the Remnant are driven off the moon. Local frame: +x faces the station.

zone.note: Issue #308: a ring of radius metres round the outpost is a checkpoint zone. Below the wave band the nearest trooper (a role below) who sees you walks up and the gate's card opens, on the gate's rules (content/core/soldiers/gate_guard.json checkpoint block; anything in this checkpoint block wins). Leave the ring and the card closes; cleared, the outpost leaves you alone for cleared_s.
